subject: [PATCH v4 12/14] selftests/nfsd: add a per-netns rpcbind stub and the listener round-trips

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch adds a per-netns rpcbind stub to the selftests/nfsd suite, allowing tests to run within their own network namespace. The stub serves as a minimal responder that answers RPCBVERS_4 and RPCBVERS_2 requests, counts accepted connections and received calls, and shares mode information with the test. With this stub in place, additional tests are added to cover various scenarios, including listener creation, addition, removal, and round-trips for TCP, UDP, and IPv6 listeners. The patch also includes fixes for netlink socket configuration and teardown procedures to prevent namespace leaks.
